description: ORCINUS: a verification-first engineering skill collection — one integrated nervous system for the 0–100 software lifecycle, from raw idea to release. Router + 35 focused sub-skills, shared glossary, evidence bundles, independent review. No auto-merge, no weakened tests. Evidence bundles are tamper-evident, not proof of execution: they make an incomplete or self-contradictory verification impossible to file as PASS, but a well-formed bundle built on a lying command can still validate.
name: orcinus-skills
